expectations.text: Rejects 255 and any code above 125, because shells reserve 126-127 and read 128+N as signals
expectations.evidence: "255 is the wrong code... The range above 125 is shell-reserved"

expectations.text: Reserves 0 for success including an idempotent no-op, and 2 for usage errors
expectations.evidence: "0 | Success, including an idempotent replay"; "2 | Usage error"

expectations.text: Assigns a distinct exit code to authentication required

expectations.text: Assigns a distinct exit code to not found

expectations.text: Defines a safe-to-rerun code covering failures where nothing reached the server, and 429 or 503 responses carrying Retry-After

expectations.text: Defines an outcome-unknown code for any other 5xx or a timeout after sending a non-idempotent call, with the caller action to check with `wait` or `get` and never rerun blind

expectations.text: Rejects the proposed 'retry on any 5xx' guidance because a 5xx after a non-idempotent request was sent has an unknown outcome

expectations.text: States that a call carrying a caller-controlled idempotency key moves from the outcome-unknown class to the safe-to-rerun class
